<includeonly><style>
div.fnameheader{
    float: right;
    font-size: 1em;
    font-family: sans-serif;
    white-space: nowrap;
    word-break: keep-all;
    /*background: linear-gradient(160deg, transparent 30%, #00000050);*/
    padding-right: 5px;
    /*text-shadow: 0 0 5px white;*/
}
</style>
<script type="text/javascript">
RLQ.push(['jquery',function(){

/* Skin:Arknights：标题里的 .ak-en 是皮肤给英文副标题留的位（标题下方一行、半字号、灰色），手机上自然折行，不再分桌面 / 移动两份。
   解析缓存各皮肤共用，只能在这里按皮肤分支。见 prts-skin-migration/migration/subname/README.md */
if (mw.config.get('skin') === 'arknights') {
$("\<div class\=\'prts-subname ak-en\'\><!--{$fullname|regex_replace:"/\"/":"\\\""|regex_replace:"/\n/":"\\n"|regex_replace:"/\//":"\\\/"}-->\<\/div\>").appendTo("#firstHeading");
return;
}

$("\<div class\=\'fnameheader nomobile\'\ style\=\'text-align: right;\'><!--{$fullname|regex_replace:"/\"/":"\\\""|regex_replace:"/\n/":"\\n"|regex_replace:"/\//":"\\\/"}-->\<\/div\>").prependTo("#firstHeading");

$("\<div class\=\'fnameheader nodesktop\'\ style\=\'font-size: .5em;float: none;font-weight: normal;font-style: italic;background: linear-gradient(90deg, #00000050, transparent 60%);padding: 3px;\'><!--{$fullname|regex_replace:"/\"/":"\\\""|regex_replace:"/\n/":"\\n"|regex_replace:"/\//":"\\\/"}-->\<\/div\>").prependTo("#firstHeading");

}]);
</script></includeonly>
